Ravi (PM): quick: new customer pilot wants private deploy next sprint. need minimal handoff + owners.
Mae (Eng PM): must-haves: tenant isolation, p95 <1s for core routes, KMS, and 5% canary with rollback.
Ivy (Runtime): model = 13B. can meet p95 with 8-bit quant + prefix cache. will run perf delta on eval set in 48h.
Sofia (Infra): infra asks: VPC peering, subnet for reserved GPUs, vendor PO. network diagram + slot request in 24h; provisioning depends on PO (5bd).
Raj (Security): KMS preference: CMK recommended. Redwood-managed keys workable for pilot if rotation documented. need SIEM ingest + audit checklist.
Elliot (SRE): dashboards: p95/p99, error-rate, GPU mem. will stub dashboards in 24h and provide rollback script in 48h.
Mae (Eng PM): owners: Sofia=deployment, Ivy=perf signoff, Raj=security signoff, Ravi=customer signoff, Elliot=on-call.
Ravi (PM): risks: PO delay -> hosted fallback for canary (customer must approve). quant regression -> fallback to FP16.
Ivy (Runtime): will add auto-switcher to FP16 on quality regression > threshold.
proxy-bot: calendar: vendor-po-check 1776005400
Ravi (PM): please drop ETAs by EOD. I'll assemble a 1-pager for the customer. :handshake:
